title: Qualification baseline and known boundary
summary: The Font Manager dev3 and PDF dev5 baselines are qualified against ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196. Font Manager proves intentions, Fontconfig discovery, exact metrics, subsetting, glyph planning and mixed-script fallback; PDF proves embedded subset Unicode CID TrueType fonts and exact multilingual text extraction.
invariants: Qualification evidence names the interpreter baseline and external providers used.
No source package bundles a font binary.
Mixed-script fallback qualification must produce zero missing glyphs for its declared corpus on the qualification host.
PDF qualification requires independent pdffonts/pdftotext evidence rather than self-validation only.
The pure-ooRexx fixed-Huffman compressor performance limit is recorded separately from managed-font correctness.

provenance.claim: Core, intentions, live Fontconfig, exact metrics and live subset qualification passes.
Mixed-script fallback result and explicit shaping boundary.
PDF core/flow/rich regressions plus embedded subset Unicode CID TrueType and multilingual extraction pass; compression performance note retained.
